questions.title: Review date imputation against the analysis guide
questions.excerpt:
For ASTDT in ADAE, this date was converted to numeric SAS date from AE.AESTDTC. If
the day component is missing, a value of ‘01’ is used. If both the month and day are missing
no imputation is performed. See define.xml.
questions.guidance: Compare the day-only imputation rule with ASTDT and ASTDTF, including missing month/day handling and the retained Define-XML method. Record the intended interpretation in a comment.

The current named-source lookup cannot compare values against the absent ADSL.TRTDUR column.
